description: What a place is usually like in a given month, for trip planning months ahead: per month, sea-surface temperature (p10/p50/p90 °C), wave height (p50/p90 m), wind (p50/p90 m/s), share of rough days, model water visibility (p25/p50/p75 m, low confidence), tropical-cyclone frequency, wildlife seasons, access rules and best activities. Every field carries its sources; curated seasons are drafts pending local review. Pass an area id, a spot id, or lat+lon, and optionally a month range. Free.

lat.description: Latitude; resolves to the nearest covered area within 50 km. Use with lon.

month_to.description: Last month, 1-12, inclusive; wraps the year (11 to 2 = Nov-Feb).

spot.description: Spot id; resolves to the area containing it.

name: get_seasonality
title: Get seasonality (trip planning)
